🌿 Branching model: integration (default; not set in .dev-cycle.json)
   Long-lived branches : main, dev
   Work branches       : feat/, fix/, docs/, ... from 'dev', pull requests into 'dev'
   Release candidate   : vX.Y.Z-rc.N tagged on 'dev' after the version bump
   Release gate (user) : the user merges the pull request 'dev' -> 'main'; tag-on-merge creates vX.Y.Z and the release
   Hotfix              : hotfix/<slug> from 'main', pull request into 'main', then 'main' merged back into 'dev'
